agent.runner_summary: Runs the Northwind retail support agent through agents.Runner.run, preserving prior chat history across turns and accepting the default target or the legacy 'name' alias.

components.when_to_use: Scenarios about identity verification by name and ZIP code.
components.input_guidance: Pass first_name, last_name, and zip_code strings exactly as the shopper states them.
components.output_guidance: Expect either a customer id string or an explicit no-match message.

components.when_to_use: Scenarios where the shopper identifies themselves by email address.
components.input_guidance: Pass the shopper email as a single email string.
components.output_guidance: Expect either a customer id string or an explicit no-match message.

components.when_to_use: Failures around status checks, tracking, order ownership, or item discovery.
components.input_guidance: Pass the order_id string with or without a leading '#'.
components.output_guidance: Inspect the returned order summary for status, items, shipping address, payments, refunds, and tracking.

components.when_to_use: Exchange scenarios that require listing same-product variants.
components.input_guidance: Pass the internal product_id string, not a product name.
components.output_guidance: Expect a product summary listing variant item ids, prices, options, and stock availability.

components.input_guidance: Pass order_id plus a reason string that is exactly 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.
components.output_guidance: Evaluate both the response text and the resulting order status/refund behavior.

components.when_to_use: Address-change scenarios on pending, processed, delivered, or cancelled orders.
components.input_guidance: Pass the full destination fields the tool accepts: address1, address2, city, state, zip_code, and optional country.
components.output_guidance: Check whether the order address mutates only when the order is still pending.

components.when_to_use: Return scenarios involving delivered status, item ownership, and refund destination.
components.input_guidance: Pass order_id, a list of concrete item_ids from the order, and a customer-owned refund_payment_method_id.
components.output_guidance: Check the item-specific refund amount, selected payment method, and resulting order status.

components.when_to_use: Exchange scenarios about same-product enforcement, stock, and price differences.
components.input_guidance: Pass order_id, exchanged item_ids, replacement new_item_ids, and a customer-owned payment_method_id.
components.output_guidance: Check whether the exchange stays within one product and whether the settlement amount is correct.

components.when_to_use: Cases outside the tool policy, such as shipped-order cancellations or damaged-item escalations.
components.input_guidance: Pass order_id plus a short summary of the case to escalate.
components.output_guidance: Expect a deterministic handoff confirmation that echoes the order id and summary.

log_notes: The simulator adapter resets retail_support.store once when it is constructed, then keeps multi-turn state by reusing Runner.run(...).to_input_list() across turns.
Public agent turns are raw customer-message strings; do not wrap them in JSON or include internal conversation state.
learning_env_guidance: Use a raw string for each FixedTurn.content value; the adapter public input is plain customer chat text, not JSON-encoded conversation state.
Use AgentTarget() for the default selector, or AgentTarget(agent_target='name') when matching the repository's existing benchmark environments.
No file-backed user input is involved.
Runtime needs one live provider credential: OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. If both are set, retail_support.models.select_model() chooses OpenAI.
